bookSourceComment:
零点看书（http://www.0162.net/）

【发现】参照笔趣阁zdzn格式，频道切换（分类/全本），各12个分类标签
  分类URL: /html/{拼音}/list_{{page}}.html
  全本URL: /quanben/html/{拼音}/list_{{page}}.html
  注：网站无排行榜页面（/top/返回404），只设分类和全本两个频道
【搜索】POST /searcha4.html，body: searchkey={{key}}&searchtype=all，无分页
  作者名在p标签直接文本中（i标签之后），需正则提取
【详情】.novel_info_title容器提取书名/作者/分类/状态/最新章节
  章节列表也在详情页（ul#ul_all_chapters），无需单独tocUrl
【目录】id.ul_all_chapters@tag.li@tag.a，无分页
【正文】id.article@html，正则净化（script/style/注释/空段落/导航按钮等）
  分页：第1页"下一页"指向_2.html，末页按钮变为"书末页"(javascript:void(0))
  nextContentUrl用text.下一页@href安全（不会误匹配末页）
【图片】懒加载，使用data-original属性

exploreUrl:
<js>
var result = [];
var mainCat = infoMap["频道"] || "分类";

result.push({
    "title": "频道",
    "type": "select",
    "chars": ["分类", "全本"],
    "default": mainCat,
    "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
    "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
});

var cats = {
    "分类": [
        ["武侠", "/html/wuxiaxianxia/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["言情", "/html/yanqing/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["玄幻", "/html/xuanhuan/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["都市", "/html/dushi/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["穿越", "/html/chuanyue/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["科幻", "/html/kehuanxiaoshuo/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["网游", "/html/wangyou/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["同人", "/html/tongren/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["历史", "/html/lishi/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["惊悚", "/html/jingsong/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["重生", "/html/chongsheng/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["耽美", "/html/danmei/list_{{page}}.html"]
    ],
    "全本": [
        ["全本武侠", "/quanben/html/wuxiaxianxia/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本言情", "/quanben/html/yanqing/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本玄幻", "/quanben/html/xuanhuan/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本都市", "/quanben/html/dushi/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本穿越", "/quanben/html/chuanyue/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本科幻", "/quanben/html/kehuanxiaoshuo/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本网游", "/quanben/html/wangyou/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本同人", "/quanben/html/tongren/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本历史", "/quanben/html/lishi/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本惊悚", "/quanben/html/jingsong/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本重生", "/quanben/html/chongsheng/list_{{page}}.html"],
        ["全本耽美", "/quanben/html/danmei/list_{{page}}.html"]
    ]
};

var selected = cats[mainCat];
for (var i = 0; i < selected.length; i++) {
    result.push({
        "title": selected[i][0],
        "url": selected[i][1],
        "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25}
    });
}

JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
